name: Clarm
long_description: Clarm Atlas 10xes productivity for non-technical operators in high-trust, regulated teams - banks, healthcare, insurance, publicly listed companies - by letting them build their own, fully governed AI agents. Teams build agents on their own approved data: every answer cites its source, all primitives are deterministic and highly governable, every action is logged for audit, and you bring your own AI model.
one_liner: Build governed AI agents on your own data, without code

launches.title: Clarm - Zero Hallucination AI Deep Research agents
launches.tagline: Build fully automated workflows for high-trust environments
launches.body:
# **Things can only get better. 📈**

Hey, we’re [Marcus](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marcus-storm-mollard-a0514aa1/) and [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-usher/) at ◮ [Clarm](https://clarm.com?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch_yc&utm_id=1). We've worked on AI since the 2010s and in industries where perfect workflows are critical to company survival (Deutsche Bank, Amazon).

# **Problem ❌**

Deep research agents could replace much of white-collar work, but companies can't deploy them because they lack trust in the data sources and control over the reasoning process. Legal and Compliance teams block adoption because existing AI tools make things up.

# **Solution 💡**

[Clarm](https://clarm.com?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch_yc&utm_id=1) is your AI deep research agent builder for high-trust environments. Our platform connects across 40+ enterprise integrations - CRMs, email, knowledge bases - and lets you build precise, repeatable workflows that transform how teams work without the risk.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90682&key=user_uploads/2476585/fc020dbb-e97a-4980-b074-69a20242c1ef)

We’re actively developing [Clarm](https://clarm.com?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch_yc&utm_id=1) for customers such as:

* law firms to find relevant information within the thousands of emails and documents
* asset managers to evaluate proxy voting preferences across 90,000 shareholder meetings
* luxury goods retailers to increase client response rate from 5% to 50% through deep personalization (as compared to standard Hubspot-generated marketing copy)
* fast-growing startups to onboard new hires instantly with bespoke training material created on their own customer calls
* top open source startups to increase engagement with their Github repo and knowledge base
* services firms to instantly answer '000s of client support questions, driving up engagement and turning curious prospects into committed customers

https://youtu.be/on2OVIuO62M

# **Team 👏**

Marcus led the first AI team at a major Corporate Bank, growing it to $10m ARR in 2 years. After a Visiting Research Fellowship at the University of Oxford, he built the world’s most accurate consumer goods forecasting model for the world’s largest market researcher, scaling it from 0 to $7m ARR in 2 years. Marcus has worked all over the world and speaks 8 languages (on a good day).

Alex built and maintained payment systems at Amazon Prime Video, processing $bns per year. He was top of his class at Imperial College London and holds numerous industry awards and publications.

# **Our ask 🙏**

We’d like intros to buyers at high trust firms, like finance, luxury, and law.

We’d also be open to working with you directly if you sell into these firms and need precise, on-prem deep research agents to power your products.

We’d love to hear from you! Get in touch at [marcus@clarm.com](mailto:marcus@clarm.com). **Thank you.**
